verdict.rationale: Xero's own docs describe paying multiple bills in one go: you export a payment file and upload it to your bank, and the bills are then marked as paid. JAX, its AI assistant, also categorizes and matches bank transactions for you. This shows first-party bulk capability, but only for bill payments and reconciliation, and the payment path depends on an export-and-upload step. missing for 10: general bulk edit/delete/create across item types, documented batch API or MCP bulk operations for agent-driven workflows, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Export a payment file from Xero and upload it directly to your online banking to pay multiple bills in one go.
Pay multiple bills at once and automate reconciliation ensuring records are always up-to-date.
Let JAX categorize and match transactions while you're busy with your real work.
